text: Aurelia Steel - Annual Climate Report 2024. In 2024 Aurelia Steel produced 12.6 million tonnes of crude steel across its three integrated sites. Gross Scope 1 emissions were 24,190,000 tCO2e, and Scope 2 emissions (market-based) were 1,310,000 tCO2e. Aurelia Steel is committed to reaching net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, with an interim target of a 35% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 against a 2018 baseline.

Kestrel Metals plc - Sustainability Report 2024. Crude steel output: 3.1 Mt. Our Scope 1 emissions fell to 5.9 MtCO2e (2023: 6.2 MtCO2e) and Scope 2 emissions were 0.21 MtCO2e. The Board has approved a net zero target for 2045, five years ahead of the UK national target.

Lianhe Iron & Steel Group - Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2023. In 2023 the Group produced 21.4 million tonnes of crude steel. Greenhouse gas emissions (unit: 10,000 tonnes CO2): direct emissions (Scope 1) 4,108; indirect emissions from purchased electricity (Scope 2) 512. The Group will strive to peak carbon emissions before 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060.

Rio Claro Siderurgica S.A. - Relatorio de Sustentabilidade 2024 (English summary). Crude steel output reached 6,8 million tonnes. Scope 1 emissions: 12.920.400 tCO2e. Scope 2 emissions: 402.100 tCO2e. The company reaffirms its ambition to be net zero by 2050.

Tamarind Steel Ltd - Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report FY2024. Crude steel production rose 6% to 18.2 million tonnes. Our CO2 emission intensity improved to 2.31 tCO2 per tonne of crude steel (tcs), from 2.38 tCO2/tcs a year earlier. Tamarind Steel targets net zero by 2070, in line with India's national commitment.

Fjordstal ASA - Climate Accounts 2024. Fjordstal operates two electric arc furnaces supplied with Norwegian hydropower and produced 0.74 million tonnes of crude steel in 2024. Scope 1 emissions: 61,300 tCO2e. Scope 2 emissions (market-based): 4,100 tCO2e. Target: net zero across Scope 1 and 2 by 2040.

Great Lakes Ironworks Inc. - 2024 Sustainability Report. Key performance data: Scope 1 emissions (MtCO2e) 2022: 14.9 | 2023: 14.2 | 2024: 13.8. Scope 2 emissions (MtCO2e) 2022: 1.1 | 2023: 1.0 | 2024: 0.96. Raw steel production (Mt) 2022: 7.9 | 2023: 7.6 | 2024: 7.4. We remain committed to net zero by 2050.

Hokuriku Special Steel Co., Ltd. - Integrated Report 2025. Results for FY2024 (April 2024 to March 2025): crude steel production 2.05 million tonnes; CO2 emissions Scope 1: 3,690 kt-CO2; Scope 2: 1,020 kt-CO2. We aim to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050.

Ostend Metals NV - Sustainability Statement 2024 (ESRS E1). Crude steel production: 4.4 Mt. Combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions amounted to 8.7 MtCO2e, a 4% decrease year on year. Ostend Metals is committed to net zero emissions by 2050.

Sahara Steel Holdings - Sustainability Report 2024. The group produced 5.6 million tonnes of crude steel through its DRI-EAF route. Scope 1 emissions: 6,050,000 tCO2e; Scope 2: 1,480,000 tCO2e. We target a 20% reduction in emission intensity by 2030 compared with 2020.

Anatolia Celik A.S. - 2024 Sustainability Report. Liquid steel production: 9.8 million tonnes; shipments: 8.1 million tonnes. Scope 1 emissions: 4,120,000 tCO2e; Scope 2 emissions: 2,350,000 tCO2e. In line with Turkiye's long-term climate strategy, we target net zero by 2053.

Pacifica Steel Limited - Climate Report FY2024 (year ended 30 June 2024). Steel production: 5.3 Mt. Scope 1 emissions: 10.6 Mt CO2-e; Scope 2 emissions: 0.9 Mt CO2-e. Pacifica Steel's ambition is net zero by 2050, subject to the availability of affordable renewable energy and green hydrogen.

Vistula Huta S.A. - Non-financial Report 2023. Crude steel production in 2023 amounted to 4.9 million tonnes. Scope 1 emissions: 6,240 kt CO2; Scope 2 emissions: 1,105 kt CO2. The company has set a goal of climate neutrality by 2050.

Meridian Steel Ltd - Climate Change Report 2024. Our value-chain (Scope 3) emissions are estimated at 21.3 MtCO2e, mainly from purchased coal and iron ore. Operational emissions were 9.2 MtCO2e (Scope 1) and 3.4 MtCO2e (Scope 2, reflecting a coal-heavy grid). Crude steel production was 4.6 Mt. Meridian has committed to net zero by 2050.

Danube Steelworks AG - Climate Report 2024. Compared with our 2019 baseline of 12.1 MtCO2, Scope 1 emissions in 2024 decreased to 10.4 MtCO2. Scope 2 emissions were 0.55 MtCO2. Crude steel production: 5.5 Mt. We aim to become climate neutral by 2050.

Corvid Specialty Alloys - ESG Data Sheet 2024. Electric arc furnace production: 1.12 Mt of crude steel. Scope 1: 198,000 tCO2e. Scope 2 (location-based): 412,000 tCO2e; Scope 2 (market-based, including renewable power purchase agreements): 156,000 tCO2e. Net zero target year: 2050.

Han River Steel Co. - Sustainability Report 2024. Han River Steel produced 38.5 million tonnes of crude steel in 2024. Direct emissions (Scope 1) totalled 77.6 million tCO2 and indirect emissions (Scope 2) 3.1 million tCO2. The company declared its goal of carbon neutrality by 2050.

Sierra Madre Aceros - Informe de Sostenibilidad 2024 (English excerpt). We produced 6.1 million tonnes of crude steel. Our direct emissions were approximately 10.9 million tonnes of CO2e. Scope 2 emissions will be disclosed from the 2025 reporting cycle. We have set a net zero target for 2050.

Bluewater Iron Corp. - 2024 Environmental Report. Shipments and production: we produced 3.3 million short tons of raw steel at our DRI-EAF facilities. Scope 1 emissions: 5.1 million metric tonnes CO2e; Scope 2: 410,000 metric tonnes CO2e. Bluewater targets net zero by 2050.

Nordic Green Steel AB - Annual Report 2024. Construction of our hydrogen-based plant is on track; first coil is expected in 2026 and the plant is designed for 2.5 Mt per year of near-zero emission steel. Scope 1 emissions in 2024, mainly from temporary gas boilers on site: 12,400 tCO2e. Scope 2: 3,900 tCO2e.
